name: FA_MC_ADJUSTMENTS
description: FA_MC_ADJUSTMENTS contains information necessary for Oracle Fusion Assets to create journal entries to the reporting set of books in General Ledger. It is a multiple reporting currency sub-table of FA_ ADJUSTMENTS.

columns.name: SET_OF_BOOKS_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the accounting ledger.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset transaction.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset accounting line.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Asset transaction type of the accounting line.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_TYPE
columns.description: The type of account this row affects.

columns.name: DEBIT_CREDIT_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether the line is Credit or Debit in the accounting entry for the asset transaction.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the account code combination to be used to account the asset transaction line.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique book identification name.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset number.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset distribution.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of asset adjustment broken down by  account type and asset distribution.

columns.name: ANNUALIZED_ADJUSTMENT
columns.description: Adjustment amount for a period multiplied by number of periods in fiscal year for retroactive transactions.

columns.name: PERIOD_COUNTER_CREATED
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation period in which the transaction was performed.

columns.name: PERIOD_COUNTER_ADJUSTED
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation period in which the transaction was effective.

columns.name: SOURCE_DEST_CODE
columns.description: Indicator of whether this line is on the source or destination side of a transaction.

columns.name: SOURCE_LINE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset source line.

columns.name: ASSET_INVOICE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset invoice.

columns.name: TRACK_MEMBER_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether the account information is created at the member asset level or at group asset level.

columns.name: DEPRN_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator as to whether the depreciation amount for the transaction is overridden or not.

columns.name: CONVERTED_FLAG
columns.description: Status indicating whether the transaction amounts have been converted to the reporting currency.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INSERTION_ORDER
columns.description: Order of insertion for mass transactions.

columns.name: COUNTERPARTY_DIST_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the counterparty asset distribution for a book transfer transaction.

columns.name: COUNTERPARTY_BAL_SEG_VAL1
columns.description: Primary balancing segment value from the counter asset distribution for a transfer between books transaction.

columns.name: COUNTERPARTY_BAL_SEG_VAL2
columns.description: Second balancing segment value from the counter asset distribution for a transfer between books transaction.

columns.name: COUNTERPARTY_BAL_SEG_VAL3
columns.description: Third balancing segment value from the counter asset distribution for a transfer between books transaction.

columns.name: COUNTERPARTY_CC_SEG_VAL
columns.description: Cost center segment value from the counter asset distribution for a transfer between books transaction.
